span.p:
SET p, v [d]
gpio[p] ← v
other pins unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_OUT [d]
gpio[0] ← shift_reg[0]
shift_reg ← shift_reg >> 1
(same edge, then hold)
takes 1 + d cycles

span.p:
PULL [d]
shift_reg ← FIFO head
pins unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles
after the stall

span.p:
JMP target [d]
